# European Union

> > Official portal of the European Union providing comprehensive information on EU institutions, member states, policies, and the history of European integration.

This site serves as the primary information hub for understanding the European Union's structure, governance, and operations. It covers the 27 member states, key institutions like the European Parliament, European Commission, and European Central Bank, as well as major policy areas including the single market, Schengen area, and research and innovation programs.

## Key Topics

- European Union institutions (Parliament, Commission, Council)
- EU member states and country profiles
- Schengen area and euro area
- Single market and trade policy
- European integration and EU history
- EU pioneers and founding figures
- Brussels and Strasbourg (institutional seats)
- Eurostat and EU statistics
- Research and innovation programs
- Political systems across Europe
- EU budget and financial framework
- Europe Day celebrations
- Post-war European cooperation

## EU Foundations and Priorities

- [Principles, countries, history](https://european-union.europa.eu/principles-countries-history_en): EU formation, principles, member states, symbols & Schuman Declaration
- [Priorities, actions, achievements](https://european-union.europa.eu/priorities-and-actions_en): EU strategic priorities including Ukraine support & COVID-19 response
- [Single market, capital markets union](https://european-union.europa.eu/priorities-and-actions/actions-topic/single-market_en): EU single market: free movement of goods, services, capital & persons
- [Research and innovation – EU action](https://european-union.europa.eu/priorities-and-actions/actions-topic/research-and-innovation_en): EU research & innovation investment via Horizon 2020 and framework programs

## EU Member States

- [Belgium – EU country](https://european-union.europa.eu/principles-countries-history/eu-countries/belgium_en): Belgium profile: federal monarchy, economy, Schengen & euro area member
- [Netherlands – EU country](https://european-union.europa.eu/principles-countries-history/eu-countries/netherlands_en): Netherlands profile: political system, economy, EU representation & funding
- [Ireland – EU country](https://european-union.europa.eu/principles-countries-history/eu-countries/ireland_en): Ireland profile: parliamentary republic, euro area, Schengen opt-out
- [Sweden – EU country](https://european-union.europa.eu/principles-countries-history/eu-countries/sweden_en): Sweden profile: political system, Swedish krona, Schengen area member
- [Bulgaria – EU country](https://european-union.europa.eu/principles-countries-history/eu-countries/bulgaria_en): Bulgaria profile: political system, economy, EU institutions & Schengen
- [Latvia – EU country](https://european-union.europa.eu/principles-countries-history/eu-countries/latvia_en): Latvia profile: parliamentary republic, eurozone & Schengen area member

## EU Budget and Trade

- [Budget negotiation process](https://european-union.europa.eu/institutions-law-budget/budget/how-eu-budget-adopted_en): EU budget negotiation: Parliament, Council & multiannual financial framework
- [Import, export, trade in the EU](https://european-union.europa.eu/live-work-study/import-and-export_en): EU trade rules, customs tariffs, TARIC database & import/export procedures

## EU Pioneers and History

- [Robert Schuman – EU pioneer](https://european-union.europa.eu/principles-countries-history/history-eu/eu-pioneers/robert-schuman_en): French minister & architect of European integration via Schuman Declaration
- [Winston Churchill – EU pioneer](https://european-union.europa.eu/principles-countries-history/history-eu/eu-pioneers/winston-churchill_en): British PM who advocated United States of Europe in 1946 Zurich speech
- [Melina Mercouri – EU pioneer](https://european-union.europa.eu/principles-countries-history/history-eu/eu-pioneers/melina-mercouri_en): Greek actor & minister who created European Capital of Culture program
- [Ursula Hirschmann](https://european-union.europa.eu/principles-countries-history/history-eu/eu-pioneers/ursula-hirschmann_en): Anti-fascist feminist who created European Federalist Movement

## Contact and Visit

- [Contact the EU](https://european-union.europa.eu/contact-eu_en): Contact EU via EUROPE DIRECT, multilingual support & institutional contacts
- [Plan a visit to an EU institution](https://european-union.europa.eu/contact-eu/visit-european-union-institution_en): Plan visits to EU institutions including Parliament, Council & Commission

## News and Events

- [Press releases](https://european-union.europa.eu/news-and-events/press-releases_en): Official press releases from EU institutions & agencies
- [European Central Bank](https://european-union.europa.eu/news-and-events/events/european-central-bank-2025-05-10_en): ECB Open Day event in Frankfurt am Main, Germany
